import pandas as pd

def main():
    # List all source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_55/test_0.csv"
    ]

    # List to hold dataframes from all sources
    dfs = []

    # Load each source file, transform and append to dfs
    for file_path in source_files:
        # Read source CSV
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

        # Transform: Extract V_GENE from J_CALL by splitting on '*'
        df['V_GENE'] = df['J_CALL'].str.split('*').str[0]

        # Select only the target column
        df_target = df[['V_GENE']]

        dfs.append(df_target)

    # Concatenate all transformed dataframes (if multiple sources)
    result_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Write the result to the target CSV file
    result_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_55/target_multisource_cot.csv", index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
